title: Add Built‑in Request Body Validation Middleware
description: Provides a declarative way to validate JSON request bodies against a schema before reaching route handlers, reducing boilerplate and preventing malformed data from entering the app. The middleware integrates with existing routing and returns standardized 400 errors with detailed messages.
testCases: Valid JSON matching schema passes through and reaches the handler
Invalid JSON (missing required field) returns 400 with error details
Invalid type for a field returns 400 with appropriate message
Non‑JSON content‑type bypasses validation and proceeds unchanged
acceptance: The middleware can be attached to any route via router.use or router.post('/path', validateBody(schema), handler). All test cases pass, existing routes remain unaffected, and error responses follow the framework's error format.
reason: Ensures data integrity at the edge of the application, reduces duplicated validation code, and improves security and developer productivity, aligning with the framework's stability‑focused roadmap.
